security_audit.summary: Most static findings are false positives caused by Markdown code fences, TypeScript template literals, placeholder API examples, and normal application patterns. The starter assets make two low-risk public demo API requests. The PowerShell bootstrap script intentionally executes npm and npx commands, creating a medium supply-chain exposure that requires informed user execution.

remediation.issue: The PowerShell bootstrap script installs and executes latest package versions through npm and npx.
remediation.suggestion: Require user confirmation before running the script, pin or document reviewed package versions, and show the commands before execution.

remediation.issue: Starter pages request data from a third-party public demo API.
remediation.suggestion: State that the requests are demo-only and replace them with local fixtures or a configurable endpoint before production use.

content.value_statement: Next.js 16 changes can make new projects and migrations difficult to plan. This skill provides focused patterns, a migration checklist, starter assets, and an optional PowerShell bootstrap script.
actual_capabilities: Explains Next.js 16 App Router, Turbopack, Cache Components, and proxy.ts patterns.
Provides a v15 to v16 migration checklist with recommended codemod steps.
Supplies examples for Server Components, caching, streaming, Server Actions, and route protection.
Includes a starter App Router project with loading, error, dashboard, and proxy examples.
Includes an optional PowerShell script to scaffold or upgrade a Next.js project.
limitations: Targets Next.js 16 and React 19.2 patterns, not Pages Router projects.
Examples use placeholder APIs and application-specific database objects that require adaptation.
The bootstrap script uses current npm and npx packages and requires PowerShell and Node.js 20.9 or later.
The skill does not deploy applications or validate a completed migration automatically.

use_cases.title: Start a modern application
use_cases.description: Set up a new App Router project with Turbopack, TypeScript, ESLint, Tailwind, and recommended configuration.

use_cases.title: Plan a version migration
use_cases.description: Update a Next.js 15 application for async request APIs, proxy.ts, and Cache Components.

use_cases.title: Review production architecture
use_cases.description: Choose server, client, caching, streaming, and authentication boundaries for a Next.js 16 feature.

prompt_templates.title: Create a project
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me create a Next.js 16 App Router project with TypeScript, Tailwind, Turbopack, and a simple home page.

prompt_templates.title: Add a cached page
prompt_templates.prompt: Show me how to build a Next.js 16 blog page with Cache Components, cacheLife, and a Suspense boundary.

prompt_templates.title: Migrate an application
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a step-by-step migration plan from Next.js 15 to 16. Cover async params, middleware.ts to proxy.ts, and configuration changes.

prompt_templates.title: Review architecture
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this Next.js 16 feature design. Identify the correct Server Component, Client Component, cache, Server Action, and proxy.ts boundaries.

output_examples.input: Create a migration plan for a Next.js 15 dashboard.
output: A prioritized checklist for async request APIs and proxy.ts.
Configuration changes for Cache Components and Turbopack.
Validation steps and common migration pitfalls.
A cache strategy for product data and reviews.
A Suspense boundary for independently loaded reviews.

best_practices: Confirm the installed Next.js and React versions before applying migration steps.
Use placeholder endpoints only for examples and configure production endpoints separately.
Review package commands and lockfile changes before running the bootstrap script.
anti_patterns: Do not use this skill for Pages Router or earlier Next.js versions.
Do not place cookies or headers inside a cached scope without extracting required values first.
Do not run installation commands without reviewing their package sources and project impact.

faq.question: Which Next.js versions does this skill support?
faq.answer: It focuses on Next.js 16 and its migration path from Next.js 15.

faq.question: Does it support the Pages Router?
faq.answer: No. The guidance and assets target the App Router.

faq.question: What tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: It is listed for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Does the bootstrap script modify my project?
faq.answer: Yes. It can run a codemod, install packages, and scaffold a project. Review it before use.

faq.question: Are the API URLs ready for production?
faq.answer: No. The examples use placeholder or public demo endpoints and need replacement.

faq.question: Does the skill deploy my application?
faq.answer: No. It provides development guidance and does not perform deployment automation.
